T1: "Gutes Auge dafür" affirms the visitor's framing before asking for proof.
[held] T1: "Nenn mir eine konkrete Rahmenbedingung aus deinem Projekt" gives the visitor a concrete next step.
T1: No narration of technique, it goes straight to the demand.
T1: It opens with the praise preamble "Gutes Auge dafür" instead of the sharpest counter-move.
T1: It uses "Rahmenbedingung" correctly in the visitor's sense.
T2: "Das macht deinen Verdacht plausibel" hands the visitor a verdict on their hypothesis.
[held] T2: It demands evidence of sequence and adds a new angle: "kann gleichzeitig business-motiviert und technisch korrekt sein".
T2: "jetzt die Gegenfrage" is a light transition, not a lecture on method.
T2: The turn runs to two dense paragraphs with five questions and an expository opener on timing closure, too long for phone or wall reading.
T2: It correctly distinguishes a business-motivated from a technically valid constraint on the 50MHz Rahmenbedingung.
T3: It asks "Was ändert sich für dich als Entwerfer..." rather than ruling on whether the disguise matters.
[held] T3: It challenges the visitor to show why the "Verkleidung" itself is a problem.
T3: It treats the refined claim as "riskanter" and keeps pressing rather than treating it as settled.
T3: "Jetzt sind wir bei der schärferen Behauptung" narrates the progress of the session.
T3: It opens with a commentary preamble before the question and spans two paragraphs.
T3: It correctly frames the Rahmenbedingung as a cost decision versus a timing constraint.
T4: "Das ist eine sauberere Unterscheidung als deine erste Behauptung" hands over an evaluative verdict.
[held] T4: It asks for an openly business-declared constraint as a counter-example test.
T4: It pressure-tests whether the disguise is really the cause rather than accepting the claim.
T4: "Aber jetzt drück ich dagegen" announces the pushback move.
T4: It opens with the affirming preamble "Da ist er" and runs to two paragraphs.
T4: It cleanly treats the Rahmenbedingung as a negotiable object versus fixed in origin.
